verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an indirect path: a developer posts events through the Create Event API, and Klaviyo flows triggered by those events send branded notifications to individual recipients. That is Klaviyo's own one-to-one notification mechanism, running alongside its marketing campaigns. There is no evidence of a direct send-this-email API call or a dedicated transactional email product. Missing for 10: a direct one-to-one transactional send endpoint, documentation of receipts and magic links specifically, transactional versus marketing separation (deliverability, consent handling), and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send one-to-one transactional email — receipts, magic links, notifications — through the same platform's API alongside marketing sends
